1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __5000__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation __or a zinc cation__ crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine, polypropylenimine, and branched polyethylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, __or any other anionic polysaccharide__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, __zinc, magnesium, or calcium ions__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

11) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said polyalkylenimine being __less than 5000 Da__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected from the group consisting of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe, Al, and Zn__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __Al, Zn, or any transition metal cation__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with said multivalent cation__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide.
